notes:
Live prices on the Arbitrage page.

- Turn on Live prices and Bookbreaker reads Kalshi's and Polymarket's public prices for NFL, MLB, NBA and NHL games, then lists any pair that pays whichever side wins.
- Every pair is priced from the order book, after both venues' fees, and sized to the amount actually on offer. The profit is locked only if both bets are accepted and stand.
- Most of the time no pair pays. When that happens the page says so, rather than showing near misses.
- The switch starts off. While it is off, nothing is read.
